content.value: A steam power station spends Tk 40,00,000 per annum for coal used in the station. (10) The coal has a calorific value of 5000 kcal/kg and costs Tk 600 per ton. If the station has a thermal efficiency of 33% and electrical efficiency of 90%, find the average load on the station.
